# WicketedBags.com

> Custom and printed wicketed poly bags (also called wicket bags), made to spec in house in Brooklyn, NY, with 60+ years of making flexible packaging.

- Products: wicketed bags for bakery and bread, pita, tortillas, produce (vented, Anti-Fog), frozen food and ice, shirts and apparel, plus custom printed wicketed bags.
- Films: clear, white and metallized PE and PP; FDA-compliant films for food contact.
- Options: flat, side gusset or bottom gusset; vent holes; lip, flap and header; zippers; coatings (Anti-Fog, UV Resistant, Cold Seal, Anti-Static); wicket, hole size and spacing matched to the customer's bagger.
- Printing: flexo, up to 8 colors, or plain.
- Lead time: typically 3–4 weeks.
- Quotes: quote@wicketedbags.com or the form at https://wicketedbags.com/#quote. General: info@wicketedbags.com.
- Address: 69 Kent St, Brooklyn, NY 11222.
